reviews.review:
Alien Swarm is a bit difirent Valve game. Its like Left4Dead but from up-view. 4 soldiers fight against a horde of aliens. Players can get weapons and other things by gaining XP. Experience is gained by wining rounds. Simple.

I will start with the most important - gameplay.
It isn't as good as I realy expected it to be. I mean, I've played some survival games and some TPS also, but this one, from a side of gameplay, is a little bit dissapointment. You've got a lot of guns and reloading type is difirent - you loose bullets in a clip when realoding. AI is pretty good, but it just gets boring with time. Difficulity levels are well made here - Easy/Normal/Advanced/Expert. And you can change alien spawn mode to either hordes (waves) or regular income. Also, as an Engineer (or whatever) hacking PCs addicts and is much fun. During some of finales or hordes, players can get a slow-motion, which looks kinda cool.

The second thing - HUD and UI
User Interface is very improved here - when you take a look at other Valve games. Main menu, settings and pop-up dialogs are much much better and videos behind the menus is very cool and good-looking. But I dont realy like the HUD in game. I mean, during a strong fight and mess on a screen, I can't get whats going on with HUD, cause it is so messed up. Its sometimes hard to read and hard to understand.

Sounds
I haven't got much to say about sounds and music here. All I can say is that these surraund ambience and fight sounds are in good 'theme'.  Also, the music is not very good as sound effects are.

Graphics
Very well used and made shaders, high resolution textures, very detailed models, shiny sprites and realistic particles make this game look like one of the most resource-eating games. Seriously, graphics in this game are one of the best I've ever seen for a up-side-view game. I have nothing more to say. Just pure pleasure while looking at it.


So...
Graphics, sounds and voice acting makes this game look and feel very good, but gameplay just makes it all a bit boring. Its worth giving a try, even if its a free-to-play game. Cause as it is, I shouldnt been expecting so much.

Final score: 7.5/10
(if this game wasn't free to play, it would het 5/10 :S)
It is another free game that I can co-op with my friends.
